evaluation.ranked_on: the sample where every model has a forecast (2012-04-03 to 2026-08-25, 3619 days)
evaluation.note: QLIKE and MSE on variance (Patton 2011); MSE x1e4. Ranking uses the common sample; qlike_own is each model's own longer sample and is NOT comparable across rows. DM: Diebold-Mariano with Newey-West at the horizon and the Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold correction; negative favours the row model. |DM| >= 3 is the bar this repo uses.

rough.headline: rv5m
rough.note: H from the q-moment scaling of log vol (Gatheral, Jaisson & Rosenbaum 2018), measured on bipower variation from five-minute bars — the estimator the literature uses, now that the bars exist. The daily-range and log-VIX readings are kept as corroboration and the measured value falls inside the bracket they imply, which is an out-of-sample check on the bounds this page used to quote.

mfiv.note: Chain truncated to +/-20% of spot and >= 5 days; the tails the VIX integrates are cut, so this reads a little under the published VIX. Compared against the last VIX close, which may be a day older.

intraday.note: Realised variance from five-minute bars, regular hours, plus the squared overnight return. The two tile the calendar day exactly, so this is on the same footing as close-to-close variance and as VIX, which prices a 24-hour clock. Jump share is the part of total variance the Barndorff-Nielsen-Shephard test attributes to discontinuities at the 99.9% level, with the overnight gap counted as one.

race.rv_definition: rv_total = sum of squared 5-minute RTH log returns + squared overnight return; target unchanged (close-to-close vol over the next 21 trading days)

caveat: Daily SPY bars come from FMP via macro.db, VIX and VIX3M from FRED, and the surface from the latest option snapshot. The forecast race is out of sample with parameters refit monthly. Realised variance, the jump decomposition and the roughness estimate are computed from 5-minute IBKR bars covering 3788 sessions from 2011-09-01, regular hours, with the overnight gap added back as a squared close-to-open return so the measure sits on the same 24-hour clock as VIX. VIX itself is not entitled on this IBKR subscription (error 354) and still comes from FRED.
